notice.signIn: Sign in to view your learning memory.
notice.chooseEnrollment: Choose an enrollment to view your learning memory.
notice.accountChanging: Memory is unavailable while your account changes. Reopen it after signing in.
notice.lessonUnavailable: This lesson is no longer available. Return to the course to choose another lesson.
error.notUpdated: Memory could not be updated. Your draft is still here. Try again when the connection is available.
error.STALE_REVISION: Your memory or progress changed elsewhere. Refresh the saved version, then review your draft before saving again.
error.PROPOSAL_SOURCE_CHANGED: The source for this suggestion changed. Refresh and review its references before deciding again.
error.PROPOSAL_NOT_FOUND: This suggestion is no longer available. Refresh to see the current suggestions.
error.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session expired. Sign in again to view your memory.
error.FORBIDDEN: You no longer have access to this learning memory.
error.NETWORK_UNCERTAIN: The connection was interrupted. A submitted change may already be saved. Retry the same change to confirm it.
error.PENDING_UNCERTAIN: An earlier change is unconfirmed. Resolve that saved request before making another change.
error.INVALID_REQUEST: Check the form: each prior-knowledge claim needs text, and each objective can appear only once.
error.INVALID_RESPONSE: The saved memory could not be read safely. Refresh before making another change.
error.EVIDENCE_NOT_FOUND: That evidence is no longer available. Refresh to see your current evidence.
error.EVIDENCE_CONTROL_UNCHANGED: That result already has this setting, or its review was closed. Refresh to see its current state.
error.EVIDENCE_INVALIDATED: This result no longer counts, so there is nothing left to dispute.
error.EVIDENCE_DISPUTE_LIMIT: You have 20 open disputes. Wait for a review, or withdraw one, before raising another.
error.CSRF_REJECTED: Your session could not authorize this change. Reopen the signed-in course and try again.
error.ORIGIN_REJECTED: Your session could not authorize this change. Reopen the signed-in course and try again.
error.unavailable: Memory is temporarily unavailable. Your draft is still here; no result has been assumed.
error.emptyClaim: Add a short statement to each prior-knowledge claim, or remove the empty claim.
fatal.enrollmentUnavailable: This enrollment is unavailable. It may have been removed, or your access may have changed.
notice.saved: Change saved. Assessment evidence is unchanged.
notice.refreshed: Saved version refreshed. Your draft is preserved; review it before saving.
notice.savedRefresh: Your change was saved. Refresh to see the latest memory.
header.title: A profile you can shape.
header.body: What you have shared, what your work demonstrates, and suggestions you can review.
loading.label: Loading learning memory
lesson: Lesson: {lesson}. Memory belongs to this enrollment.
uncertain.notice: An earlier memory change is unconfirmed. Retry that exact change before editing further.
externalChange: Your progress changed. Refresh memory before making another change.
evidence.title: What you have demonstrated
evidence.body: These results come from saved independent checks for this course. Preferences, prior-knowledge claims and AI suggestions cannot award credit.
evidence.empty: No objective results are available for this lesson.
families: {truncated, select, true {{count}+} other {{count}}} independent question families recorded; {required} required.
retention.retained: A later check confirmed you kept it.
retention.needsReview: A later check suggests reviewing it again.
retention.scheduledOn: A later check is scheduled for {date}.
retention.none: Retention has not been checked yet.
noGate: No assessment gate is defined for this objective.
practice: {count, plural, one {# recorded answer so far.} other {# recorded answers so far.}} Practice shows you are working on it; it is not yet a demonstration.
openDispute: A review you asked for is open. Until it is decided, this objective is shown as disputed. Your credit is unchanged while it is reviewed.
evidenceRefs.truncated: Only a bounded selection of references is shown. Search your evidence history for more.
objectivesTruncated: This snapshot shows a limited set of lesson objectives.
profile.title: Preferences & prior knowledge
profile.body: Tell us what helps you learn. These are your statements, separate from assessment evidence. Your preferences take priority over reviewed suggestions.
pace.label: Preferred learning pace
style.label: Preferred explanation style
goal.label: My learning goal
goal.note: This goal is part of your private memory. The learning goal on your profile (the one you gave when you started) is different: course staff who can see your enrollment can read it, along with your name and pace.
prior.heading: What I already know
prior.note: A claim helps guide teaching. It does not prove mastery.
prior.empty: No prior-knowledge claims in your current profile.
prior.removalNote: Removing a claim updates your current profile when you save. Earlier edits remain in your change history.
thoughts.label: My thoughts about learning
thoughts.note: Thoughts are saved in your memory and are excluded from the current AI context projection. Course staff cannot read anything you save here, in the app or in a copy of your data they download; only your own download under Your data includes it.
compare.show: Show latest saved profile for comparison
compare.hide: Hide latest saved profile for comparison
discarded: Draft discarded. Your saved profile is unchanged.
suggestions.title: AI suggestions
suggestions.body: Suggestions are proposals, not facts about you. Accept, correct or dispute them. Reviewing one never changes your grades or silently edits your preferences.
suggestions.emptyBody: No suggestions are recorded for this lesson.
suggestions.truncated: This is a limited selection. Your change history retains earlier proposals and reviews.
history.title: Questions & evidence history
history.body: Search your questions and submitted checks in {lesson}. Answers and grading keys are excluded.
history.placeholder: A word or phrase, or leave blank for recent history
history.count: {count, plural, one {# result} other {# results}} in this window. Each request checks up to 200 events and returns at most 10 results.
history.countFor: {count, plural, one {# result} other {# results}} in this window for “{query}”. Each request checks up to 200 events and returns at most 10 results.
history.noMatchesMore: No matches in this window. Earlier history is still available.
history.noMatches: No matching history in this window.
history.coverage: Search covers the first 4,000 characters of each question; matching excerpts are shortened. Earlier history loads one window at a time.
changes.title: Profile & review changes
changes.body: Earlier versions and decisions stay in this enrollment’s history. A correction changes your current statement, not earned evidence.
changes.empty: No profile edits or suggestion reviews have been recorded.
proposal.status.source_revoked: Revoked · you deleted the question it was based on
proposal.uncertainty.high: Uncertain: based on one of your activities.
proposal.uncertainty.medium: Somewhat uncertain: based on a few of your activities.
proposal.uncertainty.low: Fairly certain: based on several of your activities.
proposal.expiredNote: You did not decide on this suggestion before {date}, so it was never applied. You can still dispute it.
proposal.revokedNote: You deleted the question this suggestion was based on, so it is no longer used and cannot be accepted again.
proposal.changed: The saved review changed. Your correction and note are still here; compare them with the current suggestion before saving.
proposal.correctPrompt: Choose the version that represents you.
proposal.disputePrompt: Disputing excludes this suggestion from AI context and preserves the review history.
evidenceUse.disputedExcluded: Disputed · a review is open. Not used by your companion or supervisor.
evidenceUse.disputedIncluded: Disputed · a review is open. Your companion and supervisor may use this result.
evidenceUse.excluded: Not used by your companion or supervisor.
evidenceUse.included: Your companion and supervisor may use this result.
dispute.placeholder: For example: my answer was marked wrong but I believe it is correct.
dispute.note: Staff see that this result is disputed and review it. Your explanation stays with you. Disputing never changes credit by itself.
